assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are the repository's maintainer-defined provisional geometry (PROV-SITE-001 / PROV-KEY-001/002/003), derived from the official announcement text; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and derived metrics are provisional; the whole package (geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs) must be recomputed when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, heights and land-use partitions are concept massing generated by the agent for design discussion; they are not existing-building surveys, demolition conclusions, or approved construction scales.
assumptions.impact: Building-related metrics are design-proposal indicators only and must not be used as statutory or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines, rail alignments and primary-road lines are schematic concept lines (existing rail/road are public-knowledge level only); no surveyed redlines were used.
assumptions.impact: Traffic and municipal conclusions remain conceptual until official road redlines, rail alignments and utility data are provided.

assumptions.statement: International ecosystem case studies and industrial background claims are based on public sources listed in sources.json; they are used for mechanism learning only, not as commitments or measured local statistics.
assumptions.impact: Case studies inform design mechanisms; local indicators (innovation index, talent density) remain unknown until official statistics are published.

assumptions.statement: All event systems, community operations, brand assets, activity programs and conversion mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved government arrangements or committed investments.
assumptions.impact: Operation-related content must not be cited as confirmed implementation.
